calibration_policy: last 20 eligible train points; labels exit before validation; never choose by outcome
repeat_policy: decision repeat 0 is end-to-end repeat 0; decision repeats 1-9 reuse exactly its archived reports; end-to-end repeats 1-4 regenerate upstream
backtest_node_policy: Indicator and Alpha are deterministic Python; Pattern and Trend use vision LLM; Decision uses text LLM
sentiment_policy: verified scorer only, next-day availability for date-only, 90-day window; unknown is missing; no crawl or rescore
peer_policy: empty frozen peer set; no inferred or live company relationships
matched_information_policy: raw 45-session OHLCV plus exact selected-alpha numeric values/metrics and frozen sentiment/missingness used by Full; no LLM report embeddings
exposure_policy: Bernoulli probability from archived Full decisions on 20 train calibration points of each symbol/fold; fixed seeds; never Full test LONG rate
factor_policy: 85 causal numeric candidates; train-only orientation; fixed equal vote
failure_policy: archive failure, stop current command, no synthetic prediction; resume only under identical hashes and run identity
ledger_scope: fractional, daily close MTM, immediate cash, no tax/dividend/settlement/fill feasibility certification; continuous hold is price-only
inference_scope: descriptive effect distributions; folds/dates/repeats are dependent, not independent market observations; no superiority p-value
acceptance_scope: common-snapshot baseline evidence for R1; does not close R2/R3/R6/R9/R15 release gates or establish prospective validity
